summary: All P1 and P2 reviewer findings have been fully addressed in plan.md. Specifically: (1) mixed-target assessment warnings are attached to all known card/feature targets and omitted from general fallback warnings to prevent duplication; (2) feature status UI explicitly renders 'Status: Fresh' or 'Status: Stale' for every feature; (3) expansion state is reset via useEffect on card prop changes to ensure fresh evidence resets to initial collapsed state; (4) unresolved lineage reference IDs are projected as explicit 'Unresolved reference (id)' entries so input count matches array length; and (5) live manual check instructions mandate bounded process execution with explicit lifecycle shutdown.
